summary: Implemented module-level open and wrap_file, plus Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file, in rich/progress.py, with a private reader and context wrapper. Added 16 tests to tests/test_progress.py, two docs sections in docs/source/progress.rst, and a CHANGELOG.md bullet linking PR 1759. Edits are additive and nothing was committed. Tests, black, isort, and mypy were not run because the task forbade running code, so all results are unverified. Deviations: Progress.open is not overloaded and returns Union[TextIO, BinaryIO]; _ProgressContext subclasses typing.ContextManager, so no return suppression was needed; _ProgressReader defines mode and name properties so it can be instantiated. The buffering-above-1 passthrough is not tested.
